comparison.objective: Remove and recover insert tangs; record removes a drawer by holding two opposite-sense release levers while pulling.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate needs precision mandrel stabilization and hammering; record simultaneously actuates opposed latches, pulls a large drawer free, carries it, and sets it down.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures and contained fragments with no damage; record requires the drawer fully off both slides, flat and still on the table, and both grippers clear. Candidate quantitative tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: Simultaneous latch actuation and bulky extraction do not test impact fracture or small debris containment.
